rules.zh: 山楂、酒酿与牛乳基底暂不开放组合，配方稳定性待测试。
rules.en: Hawthorn and fermented rice with milk coffee are unavailable pending stability tests.

rules.zh: 酸味或发酵配料与乳制小料的稳定性待测试。
rules.en: Acidic or fermented ingredients with dairy toppings need stability testing.

rules.zh: 花椒可能掩盖茶香，建议分开体验。
rules.en: Sichuan pepper may overpower tea aromas; consider trying them separately.

rules.zh: 酒酿可能含酒精，含量待供应商确认。
rules.en: Fermented sweet rice may contain alcohol; supplier confirmation is needed.
